title: Orders
description: Manage service orders between customers and providers.

help.title: About orders
help.overview: An order is a job a client bought from you, from one of your listings or an accepted quote. Its price is held once you accept it, and paid out to you when the client accepts the work.

sections.title: Your steps
items: Accept order, then Start order when you begin. Extend delivery adds days to the due date; the client is told.
Submit delivery sends your work with a message and files. Only one delivery can wait for an answer at a time.

sections.title: The client's steps
items: Accept delivery completes the order and pays out what is held, less the 10% platform fee. It goes to your Stripe account if you connected one under Provider profile.
Request revision sends the work back with a reason, at most 3 times. A delivery not answered within 3 days is accepted for the client.
Milestones split the payment: the client releases each part while the work is in progress.

sections.title: Cancelling and disputes
items: You can cancel any time before the order is finished; the client only before work starts. Cancelling refunds what is still held.
Either side can open a dispute instead. While it's open, nothing is paid out or cancelled until an administrator decides.
